glosses: orphanage (a residential institution for the care and protection of orphans)

examples.en: Tom grew up in an orphanage.

examples.text: Fui criado en un orfanato en Boston.
examples.en: I was raised in an orphanage in Boston.

examples.text: Mary se hizo monja y abrió un orfanato.
examples.en: Mary became a nun and opened an orphanage.
